page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with two marginal notes in the left margin, the first beside the upper lines and the second beside the middle lines. Running head at the top, page number before it. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: pè armis · ab exulibus tum forte lacessiti Transactio cum Ailcone Hou-werd, atqueoccupati ) cum Groninganis transegit in hanc sententiam : ut ipse haberet reliqua sua omnia, prædia, jura, jurisdictiones inter Amasum, & Lavicamfl.[?] Groninganis relinqueret possessionem arcis Muntensis cum agri jugeribus cc inpignus servandæ fidei : id valeret ad transactionem plenam & perpetuam, in quam bini utrinque arbitri deligerentur. Factum, anno M. cccc. xxxviii, die Gereonis. Ludovi-cus Hornkenius præfectus arci à civita-te datus. Nec diu post compositionem hanc Ailco supervixit, & civitas anno proximo, arce minoris Muntæ ab iis, quorum erat, empta, cum Hissa uxore Ailconis vidua, atque item liberis ejus Transactio cum uxore & liberis Ailconis..denuò pepigit, in hunc modum : (Civitas Hissæ & liberis ejus omnes eorum res, quæ bono jure & sine controversia eorundem sunt, relinquit usque quò liberi omnes, aut quidam ex iis, ad justam ætatem pervenerint : tum ex formula compromissi, in quâ civitati cum vivente Ailcone convenerat, omnis controversia vel per arbitratores, vel per judices definietur in perpetuum : interea

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Lavicamfl." (the abbreviation before the full stop may be read differently); "xxxviii" is printed with a space inside the numeral, which I have set as one word. "anno M." is in small capitals. The running head "Frif." and the note "Trafactio" are read with long s as s, so the spelling in the running head and note may differ from the printed letter shapes. The first marginal note is beside the lines from "atqueoccupati" onward; the second is beside "denuò" and the lines that follow. The last printed line "civi-" is set as the catchword because it sits at the right below the last full line. The paragraph continues from the previous page.
